events.text: Born in Vladimir.

evidence.quote: Arseny Dmitrievich Mironov ( 25 December 1917 – 3 July 2019 )
Mironov was born in Vladimir .

events.text: Entered Moscow Aviation Institute (MAI), flight testing course.

evidence.quote: In 1936 , Mironov entered the Moscow Aviation Institute ( MAI )

events.text: Graduated from MAI flight testing course.

evidence.quote: Flight Testing and graduated in 1941

events.text: Started working for GFRI within USSR Minaviaprom.

evidence.quote: In May 1941 , he started working for the Gromov Flight Research Institute ( GFRI )

events.label: accident
events.text: Severely wounded in mid-air collision during La-5 test flight.

evidence.quote: On 4 October 1943 , an accident occurred in the La-5 aircrafts test flight with Mironov in the flight crew
Mironov was severely wounded and spent five months in a hospital .

evidence.quote: Arseny Dmitrievich Mironov ( 25 December 1917 – 3 July 2019 )

undated_mentions: Worked as a factory electrician two years after leaving school
Completed initial flight training at MAI aero-club with U-2 pilot licence while studying
Completed gliding flight training and several parachute jumps
Gliding training at Chkalov Central Aero-club before the war
Started as flight test engineer three days before the Great Patriotic War began
Deputy to GFRI chief (name not stated)
First deputy to GFRI chief after Max Taitz
Member of aviation accident investigation commissions
Married Olga Yevgenevna Rudneva; marriage lasted 77 years
Chief editor and author of Aviation Test Engineer Reference Bibliotheca series, early 1980s to mid-1990s
Master of Sport of the USSR in gliding
Post-war development of free-flying model aerodynamic methods
Hundreds of transport flights; USSR fourth class air transport pilot licence
